args.title: Summary: Bellwether returns logistics post + subscriber companion
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and its subscriber companion (https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion, accessed with team code SUB-3344):

• Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns logistics a major cost and operations issue for retail.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth (~20%) versus decentralized processing.
• Per the companion piece, reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as the key lever.
